tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search for pickup or destination places. Use resolve_place on the selected result before planning a trip.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve a place ID from search_places to an exact name, address, and coordinates.

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Compare ride-hailing and trotro options together. This is the default tool for multimodal trip planning.

tools.name: compare_rides
tools.description: Compare current ride-hailing prices and pickup times from the providers available through Sail.

tools.name: plan_trotro_route
tools.description: Plan public transport journeys by trotro, including fares, walking legs, transfers, and boarding instructions.

name: plan_trotro_route
description: Plan trotro journeys in Ghana, including fares, walking legs, transfers, and boarding instructions. Prefer plan_public_transport, which also covers buses in Great Britain.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "plan_trip" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Compare ride-hailing and trotro options together. This is the default tool for multimodal trip planning." → after: "Compare ride-hailing with public transport: trotro in Ghana, or buses leaving now in England, Scotland and Wales. This is the default tool for multimodal trip planning."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
